name: 近现代野战军营

approval.userStatement: 可用，继续骑兵学院系列、工程营地系列、铁匠铺系列的建模
approval.scope: Model design only; no AI refinement or runtime replacement approved by this record.

scope: Only the proposed intermediate barracks changes from a masonry fort to a tent and timber-steel lookout. Recon camp, range and all runtime assets remain unchanged.
changes: Single khaki canvas tent replaces the previous stone hall and crenellated twin towers.
Canvas slopes sag between ridge and eaves; three visible webbing seams and four guy ropes attach to stakes inside the original foundation.
Front canvas is split around a genuine doorway, with tied-back flaps, recessed dark interior and rolled window covers.
Single lower, broader timber lookout uses steel shoes and X-braces, a timber deck, open guardrails and a ladder opening with extended handrails.
The connector becomes a grounded timber walkway. Sandbags and existing supply zones remain clear of the main entrance and ladder.
No camouflage pattern, radar, vehicle, second tower, fort walls or new gameplay functions.
